templates.pattern: A clock gains [G] seconds every minute. How many minutes does it gain in [H] hours?
templates.explanation: Gain per minute = [G] seconds. In [H] hours = [H]*60 minutes. Total gain = [G]*[H] minutes.

templates.pattern: Clock A gains [GA] minutes per hour. Clock B loses [LB] minutes per hour. How many minutes apart will they be after [N] hours?
The minute hand of a clock is [M_LEN] cm long. How far does its tip travel in [N] hours? (Use π = 22/7)
How many times do the hands of a clock coincide in [N] hours?
templates.explanation: Hands coincide 11 times every 12 hours. In [N] hours = floor([N]*11/12) times.

templates.pattern: A clock loses [L] minutes every [N] hours. How many minutes will it lose in [D] days?
templates.explanation: Loss per hour = L/N. In [D] days = [D]*24 hours. Total = (L/N)*24*[D] minutes.

templates.pattern: A clock gains [G] minutes per day. How many minutes ahead will it be after [N] days?
A person was born in [Y]. How old will they be in [Y2]?
A clock strikes once at 1, twice at 2... How many times does it strike in [N] hours starting from 1 o'clock?
Two persons A and B work together every [A_DAYS] and [B_DAYS] days respectively. After how many days will they work together again?
templates.explanation: Next meeting = LCM(A_DAYS, B_DAYS). LCM([A_DAYS],[B_DAYS]) days.

templates.pattern: At 6:00, the angle between clock hands is 180°. After how many minutes will the angle be [A]° for the first time?
templates.explanation: Minute hand gains 5.5° per minute on hour hand. Time = (180-[A])/5.5 minutes.

templates.pattern: Today is [DAY_N] (as number: Mon=1...Sun=7). What day number is it [K] days later?
How many odd days are in [Y] years? (100 yrs=5, 200 yrs=3, 300 yrs=1, 400 yrs=0)
A clock was [M1] minutes slow at 3 PM Tuesday and [M2] minutes fast at 3 PM Thursday. How many hours after 3 PM Tuesday did it show correct time?
templates.explanation: Total change = M1+M2 in 48 hours. Correct time at M1/(M1+M2)*48 = [M1]/([M1]+[M2])*48 hours after 3 PM Tuesday.

templates.pattern: At [H]:[M], what is the angle between the clock hands (in degrees)?
The [N]th day of a month is [DAY_N] (Mon=1). What day number is the last day if the month has [DAYS] days?
templates.explanation: Days from Nth to last = DAYS-N. Last day = (DAY_N + DAYS - N - 1) mod 7 + 1.

templates.pattern: A clock gains [G] seconds per hour. How many seconds does it gain in [D] days?
Mirror image of clock shows [H]:[M]. What is the actual time in total minutes from 12:00?
templates.explanation: Actual time = 11:60 - mirror time. Convert to minutes from 12:00.

templates.pattern: A train runs every [N] days. Another runs daily. After how many days will they next depart together?
An ordinary year starts on day [D] (Mon=1). On which day number does it end?
How many minutes does a clock gain per day if minute hand overtakes hour hand every [X] minutes?
templates.explanation: Normal overtake = 720/11 ≈ 65.45 min. Gain/loss per day = |65.45-X|/65.45 * 1440 minutes.

templates.pattern: A leap year has [D] days. How many odd days does it have?
templates.explanation: 366 mod 7 = 2. A leap year has 2 odd days.

templates.pattern: Ram says 'Day before yesterday was [D] (Mon=1).' What day number is it today?
templates.explanation: Today = day before yesterday + 2 = D+2. Answer = ((D+1) mod 7)+1.

templates.pattern: A clock strikes [K] times at [K] o'clock. How many total strikes from 1 AM to 12 PM (noon)?
The angle between clock hands at [H]:[M] is [A]°. After how many minutes will it be 0° (hands coincide)?
templates.explanation: Hands approach at 5.5° per minute. Time to coincide = A/5.5 = [A]/5.5 minutes.

templates.pattern: In [Y] years how many leap years are there? (Assume no century year exceptions, Y starts from a leap year)
